study type: prospective multicenter observational nested cohort study
outcome: spontaneous preterm birth at < 37 weeks gestation
spontaneous preterm birth at < 34 weeks gestation
cohort: 1,697 asymptomatic nulliparous women with a singleton pregnancy
finding: Fetal adrenal size, as measured by ultrasonography between 22 0/7 and 30 6/7 weeks of gestation, was not predictive of spontaneous preterm birth in asymptomatic nulliparous women.
